legend-lake-tahoe-loop.slogan: Lake Tahoe Loop – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-lake-tahoe-loop.story: A lake loop based around South Lake Tahoe, California, via Emerald Bay. Key character: alpine lake; forest; mountain views. Surface: paved.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Tahoe Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 12 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
